name: stockwise-tools
description: Dev tooling for StockWise: headless-Chrome E2E tests, documentation screenshots, diagrams and the technical documentation builder
author: Ivan Tadena

scripts.diagrams: mmdc -i ../docs/diagrams/architecture.mmd -o ../docs/diagrams/architecture.png -c mermaid-config.json -p puppeteer-config.json -b white -s 2 -q && for d in erd-1-catalog erd-2-stock-history; do mmdc -i ../docs/diagrams/$d.mmd -o ../docs/diagrams/$d.png -c mermaid-er-config.json -p puppeteer-config.json -b white -s 2 -q; done
